resources.string: Find campus offices, explore services, and understand the next step for a request.
Chat will open after Seryo’s tasks and procedures are configured. You can browse offices while setup is underway.
AI may be wrong. Check with the office.
AI help is optional. Avoid sharing passwords, payment credentials, or sensitive student records.
Seryo provides guidance. The responsible office confirms official requirements and decisions.

Your registration agreement does not grant AI consent. Send shares a recognized service topic and a small list of public service facts with eGovAI. Your raw message is not forwarded. Do not include personal information. GoServe keeps this chat only in the active session’s memory and does not reuse the provider session. Provider retention is not controlled by GoServe.
I consent to temporary AI analysis
Sign in and refresh to verify your AI consent. Preview mode cannot record a decision.
One PDF, JPG, or PNG, up to 10 MB. Choose a non-sensitive file when Seryo is available. Selection alone does not send or analyze it.
File selection requires AI consent and an available service. Send stays unavailable until the provider connection is ready.
Planned handling: temporary analysis only, with immediate file cleanup after success or failure. Server support must be completed before uploads are enabled.
AI consent allowed. Service availability is checked separately.
AI help is off. You can reconsider here at any time.
Choose Allow or Decline. This is separate from registration Terms.
Review AI privacy to allow help. You can continue browsing campus services.
The service reports unresolved cleanup. New file analysis and retry are blocked until cleanup is verified. Removing a local selection does not confirm server deletion.
Seryo access timed out. Your unsent draft is still here. Refresh to try again.
Could not check Seryo access. Check your connection and refresh. Your unsent draft is still here.
Your consent changed. The current setting is shown; review it before choosing again.
Waiting to confirm your consent decision.
Your last consent decision may have been saved. Retry the same decision to confirm it before changing settings. Your unsent draft is still here.
A document picker is unavailable on this device. Your previous selection is unchanged.
Your account session changed. Sign in again to use Seryo.
Seryo access could not be verified. Refresh to try again.
This file could not be read or does not meet the PDF, JPG, or PNG and 10 MB limits. Any previous selection is unchanged.
Choose one file at a time. Your previous selection is unchanged.
Selected locally. Choose Explain or Extract to prepare an unsent question.
Unsent question: Explain this file. Your typed question is kept separately.
Unsent question: Extract text from this file. Your typed question is kept separately.
Review AI consent and service access here. Appearance and the read-only registration Terms are available in GoServe settings. AI consent never changes your registration agreement.

Seryo provides campus-service guidance; the responsible office confirms requirements and decisions.

When service access is available, choose one non-sensitive PDF, JPG, or PNG up to 10 MB. Explain and Extract prepare a question. Only an explicit Send may submit work.

Unsent drafts stay in this session’s memory across navigation and rotation. Closing the app process or signing out clears them. A local file removal does not confirm deletion of a file previously accepted by a server.

Seryo cannot book consultations, submit requests, set fees, or mark payments as paid.
